fields.questionText:
A carton has 24 bulbs, of which 6 are defective. One bulb is drawn at random.
(i) What is the probability that the bulb drawn is NOT defective? (1 mark)
(ii) Suppose the bulb drawn is defective and it is not put back. How many bulbs are now left in the carton, and how many of them are defective? (1 mark)
(iii) A second bulb is now drawn at random from the bulbs left in the carton (as in part (ii)). What is the probability that this second bulb is defective? (2 marks)
solutionSteps: (ii) One defective bulb is removed: bulbs left = 24 − 1 = 23; defective bulbs left = 6 − 1 = 5.
(iii) Total possible outcomes for the second draw = 23 (all equally likely); favourable outcomes (defective) = 5.
fields.finalAnswer: (i) 3/4; (ii) 23 bulbs left, of which 5 are defective; (iii) 5/23

rationale: Matches the genuine Exemplar bulb problem; removed Class-12 'conditional/given that' framing and the conceptual part (iv). Restructured as 3-part case (1+1+2 = 4). Answers 3/4, 23 & 5, 5/23 unchanged.

fields.answer: Let the number of red balls be x and the number of blue balls be y. Then 10x/100 + 20y/100 = 24, i.e. x + 2y = 240 …(i). Also 3x − y = 20 …(ii). Solving (i) and (ii): x = 40, y = 100. Number of red balls = 40 and number of blue balls = 100.

rationale: No probability involved: solves x+2y=240, 3x−y=20 (x=40, y=100 verified). Re-tagged to pair-of-linear-equations; removed marking-scheme residue '1½ 1½ 1+1' from answer.

rationale: Listing 5 favourable outcomes out of 36 is a standard 2-mark Section B item, not 3-mark C. Re-tagged; steps re-split to [1]+[1] = 2. Answer 5/36 verified.

fields.text: PA and PB are tangents drawn from an external point P to a circle with centre O. If ∠APB = 70°, find ∠AOB.

rationale: Stem fully states the set-up in words; figure not needed. Removed 'In figure'. ∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90°, so ∠AOB = 180° − 70° = 110°. Two-step item: marks 3→2.
Not a missing figure: the student is asked to DRAW their own rough sketch; 'from the graph' refers to that sketch (zeroes = x-intercepts). Self-contained as served.
